title: VMSA: Video Memory Skill Agent for Long Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.27381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-video question answering requires retrieving and integrating relevant evidence from videos spanning hours or even days. Recent agentic approaches organize video information into external memories and iteratively retrieve evidence to answer questions. However, effective retrieval and reasoning remain challenging, as agents must determine what information to search for, which memory sources to access, and how to connect evidence across distant temporal intervals. To address these challenges, we propose Video Memory Skill Agent (VMSA), a framework that jointly designs structured video memories and memory skills for long-video understanding. VMSA constructs three complementary memory components. Segment Caption Memory and Entity Event Memory serve as searchable evidence sources, while Entity-Aware Episode Memory provides broad yet detailed video context to guide evidence retrieval and reasoning. translated_title: VMSA：用于长视频理解的视频记忆技能智能体
translated_abstract: 长视频问答需要从跨越数小时甚至数天的视频中检索并整合相关证据。近期的智能体方法将视频信息组织到外部记忆中，并迭代地检索证据来回答问题。然而，有效的检索与推理仍然具有挑战性，因为智能体必须确定要搜索什么信息、访问哪些记忆源，以及如何连接跨越遥远时间间隔的证据。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了视频记忆技能智能体（VMSA），这是一个为长视频理解联合设计结构化视频记忆与记忆技能的框架。VMSA 构建了三个互补的记忆组件：片段字幕记忆和实体事件记忆作为可搜索的证据来源，而实体感知情节记忆则提供广泛而详细的视频上下文，以指导证据检索与推理。为了进一步支持有效的记忆利用……
tldr: 提出VMSA框架，通过联合设计三种互补的结构化视频记忆（片段字幕记忆、实体事件记忆、实体感知情节记忆）与记忆技能，提升智能体在长视频问答中跨长时间跨度检索与整合证据的能力。
en_tdlr: VMSA jointly designs structured video memories and memory skills, enabling agents to effectively retrieve and integrate evidence across hours-long videos for long-video question answering.
